Excel 16.114.1 statistical/information review probes, 2026-10-30

Native AppleScript automation under:
nice -n 10 lockf -k /private/tmp/claude-501/glaze-heavy.lock osascript <probe>
Excel was hidden. Each batch created and closed its own unsaved workbook. Excel
was not running initially; each batch quit only the instance it launched.
No owner workbook was read or changed.

Common data (all other cells blank):
A1=1, A2==NA(), A3=3; B1:B3=4,5,6; C1:C3=1,2,3;
E1=="text", E2=="". Follow-up: D1:D3="x",TRUE,4.
Names batch: sheet named "1", C1:C3=2,2,3.
IFS batch: B4=1. Format batches: F1 onward contain 1, assigned the
format in each line. Outputs used column Z, width 80.

The initial/follow-up batches used a different Z row for each formula, so legacy
TYPE(range) depended on that row. The precise, edge, blank and names batches
reused Z2 and explicitly calculated it. Their numeric number format was
0.000000000000000E+00. The validated batch used formula2 (modern array semantics);
all other ordinary formulas used the legacy formula property. Explicit array TYPE
used formula array at Y2. General string values show fewer significant digits.

IMPORTANT: Excel's formula setter silently rejected some inputs, leaving a prior
cached result. Those lines are raw automation observations, NOT Excel results for
the requested expression. Rejected inputs: RANK.AVG with array literals (all such
lines); _xlfn.RANK.AVG with array literals; COMBIN(1e308,1); expressions containing
1e308 literals; MAXIFS(-C1:C4,...); MINIFS/MAXIFS/AVERAGEIFS with array literals.
The validated batch records [stored: ] for rejected formulas. The blank and names
batches verify RANK.AVG with real references. No finding relies on a rejected input.

CELL(contents,blank) displays 0 but remains blank inside predicates. The edge and
blank batches demonstrate why treating that display value as a number is wrong.
TRIMMEAN's initial symmetric input did not distinguish cutoffs; the asymmetric
edge/blank batches do. Decimal literals are shown as Excel stored them.

RANK.AVG and PERCENTILE.EXC checked again before closing the review):

--- Baseline measurement ---
250000 numeric values; MAXA and MINA each threw:
RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded
LARGE and SMALL sorted their full numeric input (source inspection).
1000 array-member ISFORMULA lookups in a 10000-cell array: 104.36579100000002 ms
The deterministic lookup regression observed 1999800 member visits for 200 lookups.
